1092|fc807fb6.name: Captain Rugelfuss
1092|fc807fb6.text: At ease, $R.  This is no time for formalities.  With the Alliance forces under attack, the protection of the Dwarven territories becomes even more critical.  The recent Trogg uprising poses a dreadful threat to the King's land.

1139|a75e2b6f.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
1139|a75e2b6f.text: Well hello there, citizen. The name's Bluntnose, Magistrate Bluntnose, to be precise. I'm charged with overseeing the well-being of Thelsamar, and believe you me, we could always use another strong set of arms around here!

1154|b7c42d9a.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|b7c42d9a.text:
Here at the Farstrider lodge, we prize hunting skills above all else. Wish to gain my approval? You'll have to earn it.

You look up to the challenge, lad!

1340|e3153a3c.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|e3153a3c.text: Hello, $N.  Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!

14723|240f95e3.name: Mistina Steelshield
14723|240f95e3.text:
Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the dwarves of Ironforge, then you can start by donating valuable resources!  Ironforge finds itself running low on cloth piece; textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know!

Rather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the dwarven people of Ironforge!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

269153|dab85bcc.name: Mountaineer Ylva
269153|dab85bcc.text: <The mountaineer clearly fought bravely before meeting her end at the weapons of the troggs.>

3836|89b547f0.name: Mountaineer Pebblebitty
3836|89b547f0.text:
I don't care to hear it, $N. Nope, no way are you going to be let into the Searing Gorge. Impossible. Not going to happen. How many times do I have to tell you - I can't let you in! Do you not speak common? Are you an orc in disguise? N-O. NO!

If I let you in, then I have to let everybody in. Pretty soon your close friends will want in, then their distant relatives, then their friends, and so on and so forth. The last time that happened... well, we won't talk about the last time it happened.

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5153|4acd68fa.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|4acd68fa.text: Hmm... you show a little promise, I'll give you that. Okay then, where were we?

217-accept.name: Captain Rugelfuss
217-accept.text:
$N, our scouts have identified the leader of this recent Trogg incursion.  It appears that these beasts in Loch Modan are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug.  Grawmug is heavily guarded, however.  Two of his most elite guards, Gnasher and Brawler, never leave his side.

If you feel yourself worthy, $N, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug and his two thugs.  With the Trogg leadership dead, we just might stand a chance at pushing these beasts back into the ground.
217-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

217-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
217-complete.text: Most excellent, $N!  You have brought hope to Loch Modan.  With Grawmug dead, we stand a better chance of seeing the Troggs eliminated from the land.
217-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

237-complete.name: Mountaineer Gravelgaw
237-complete.text:
You accomplished your mission well, $r.  The King himself would be proud.

The reinforcements promised to us never showed, however.  Apparently the Alliance front is a sea of crimson from the blood of our fallen brethren.  The news of the losses leaves a bitter taste in one's mouth.  But we must not let their deaths go for naught.  We must rally in these grim times and bring glory back to the Alliance.

Speak with Mountaineer Wallbang for reassignment.  You're needed now more than ever.
237-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

255-accept.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
255-accept.text:
Two months just to hear from Ironforge that we'll be spared a handful of soldiers for our own defense, and another two months until they arrive! Bad enough that our town goes unprotected, but the excavation and the dam--the dam!--are open to attacks as well.

I've no choice then, it seems. I'll need hired arms.

How about you? You seem a likely sort, $c. A group of ogres has set up camp on the northeast of the lake. Perhaps you could recruit some others and help remove the threat to our town?
255-accept.title: Mercenaries

255-complete.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
255-complete.text: Ah, this is excellent news! Your efforts are greatly appreciated by myself and the people of Thelsamar. Better yet, if we can solve the ogre problem, we'll be able to shift our focus to those Light-burning troggs.
255-complete.title: Mercenaries

256-accept.name: Unknown
256-accept.text:
By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:

Chok'sul, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.

Monetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of Chok'sul's death.

Chok'sul was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of Loch Modan.
256-accept.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

256-complete.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-complete.text:
Yech! What is that thing? And why would you bring it...

Bloody--! Is it? Well, Light burn me, is that the head of that bloody ogre? This certainly is a catch then! Here, your reward and the thanks of myself and the people of Thelsamar.
256-complete.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

256-progress.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
256-progress.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

257-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
257-accept.text:
Think you can match wits with Daryl the Bold, huh? I should think not! Of course, you're more than welcome to try. Here's a challenge that should prove to be above your abilities, so don't feel too bad if you can't face up to it.

A flock of buzzards has nested here in Loch Modan. Why don't you try to take down some of the beasts? Tell you what, if you meet my challenge in fifteen minutes, I'll give you my bow or gun.

<He looks you over dismissively.>

It seems you haven't much to lose, anyways.
257-accept.title: A Hunter's Boast

257-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
257-complete.text:
What? Success?

Take it from me, Fatherama, you don't let it get to your head. I mean, any unshaven boy with a bow could have killed such... small specimens. And I hope you don't enjoy killing the buzzards so much, yes? We wouldn't want them to become extinct. 

Well, err... Never let it be said that Daryl the Bold would not hold to his word.
257-complete.title: A Hunter's Boast

258-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
258-accept.text:
Fatherath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? As I told you before, it's no large feat.

You should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.

Don't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!

Have I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...
258-accept.title: A Hunter's Challenge

258-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
258-complete.text:
You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.

Oh! You managed to kill the boars? I... well, that is... that is to say, I'm not surprised! Any child could have--bet?

What bet?
258-complete.title: A Hunter's Challenge

263-accept.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-accept.text:
The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, $N.  We need a $r like you around here.  The Trogg problem isn't getting any better.  The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here.  But now that we have a seasoned $c here, let's see what you can do.

Go out and kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.  Let's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.
263-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

263-complete.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-complete.text:
I knew the second I laid eyes on you, $N, that you would make Ironforge proud.  You have served King Magni well.  Now that you've proven yourself to be such a loyal aid to the Kingdom, perhaps you should talk with the Captain to see if he'll entrust you with a higher detail.

I salute you, $N.
263-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

271-accept.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
271-accept.text:
I don't suppose you'd be interested in a little payback for His Boldness? Daryl does have some skill, it pains me to say.

A year ago, a large bear had been the target of the Farstrider Lodge, but none of the hunters had any luck with him. So, Daryl thought he'd try his hand against him. All he had to show for his effort was that ugly scar over his eye.

Kill the bear, and I'm sure even Daryl would be speechless for once.

The bear, Ol' Sooty, can be found around his lair in the hills over Thelsamar.
271-accept.title: Vyrin's Revenge

297-accept.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-accept.text:
Recently, just before the Troggs surfaced within the site, we had uncovered a large number of strange, carved idols.  But we didn't have the chance to study them, for soon after their discovery the Troggs chased us away from the ruins!  And those idols have a strange effect on the Troggs.  It makes them go berserk!

Bring me 8 idols - I want to study them, and I want them out of Trogg hands!  You can find the idols on the Troggs infesting the site.
297-accept.title: Gathering Idols

297-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-complete.text:
You got them!  Nicely done, $N!

And you don't look too worse for wear, even with those berserk Troggs about.  I'm going to keep my eye on you...you show some promise.
297-complete.title: Gathering Idols

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

298-accept.name: Prospector Ironband
298-accept.text:
I need a progress report sent to Thelsamar - a progress report, and a restatement of my request for more blastpowder!  Here's the report.  Take it to Jern Hornhelm.  He's our local contact in Thelsamar.

It's not a difficult task, but it must be done.
298-accept.title: Excavation Progress Report

298-complete.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-complete.text:
Bah!  Ironband's having trouble with the Troggs.  I wonder if he wants that blastpowder to aid his digging, or to aid his efforts against the Trogg beasts...

Well, either way it's powder well spent!

But what's strange is, I sent him plenty of blastpowder weeks ago.  I wonder where it went...
298-complete.title: Excavation Progress Report

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

301-accept.name: Jern Hornhelm
301-accept.text:
We'll need approval to get Ironband more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.

Here's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of Ironband's slow progress at the site.

You'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.
301-accept.title: Report to Ironforge

353-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-complete.text:
Aha!  So Grimand finally finished my axe!  I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!

Many thanks, $N.  It was a long distance to travel for this delivery.   Here are some coins for your efforts.
353-complete.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

385-accept.name: Marek Ironheart
385-accept.text:
Many a hunter is attracted to Loch Modan to hunt our famous crocs. There are always merchants who seek out crocolisk skins for clothing items or armor, and there are also some who enjoy the taste of their meat.

We do some trade in this, but not a huge amount, as the crocolisks are ferocious and have entrenched themselves on the islands in the Loch. But don't let me dissuade you, it's quite an experience, wrestling with the jaws of the beasts.

Why, this one time...
385-accept.title: Crocolisk Hunting

436-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
436-complete.text:
Jern wants to know what the slowdown is, eh?

Ironband is putting together his latest progress report with details, but I can tell you this:

It's the Troggs!!
436-complete.title: Ironband's Excavation

455-accept.name: Mountaineer Rockgar
455-accept.text:
Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have a haven in the Wetlands.  And now they have expanded into Dun Algaz!  We can't let them keep their foothold here or Loch Modan will be cut off from Menethil Harbor, our port and stronghold in the Wetlands.

Break through Dun Algaz to the Wetlands beyond, and kill some orcs for good measure!  Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.

Menethil is through Dun Algaz, then north along the road, then west at the fork.

We're counting on you, $N.  Do not fail.
455-accept.title: The Algaz Gauntlet

468-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
468-accept.text:
Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the Wetlands.  

If you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz.  Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.
468-accept.title: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar

468-complete.name: Mountaineer Rockgar
468-complete.text:
Hello, $C!  You're here for the scouting mission, are you?  Very good!

I hope your gear is in good condition, because this "scouting" mission has changed into something more messy...
468-complete.title: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar

7802-complete.name: Mistina Steelshield
7802-complete.text: Wonderful!  We thank you for your generous donation, $N!
7802-complete.title: A Donation of Wool

7802-progress.name: Mistina Steelshield
7802-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Ironforge for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7802-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

86585-accept.name: Mountaineer Ylva
86585-accept.text:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585-accept.title: Banner of the Fallen

86585-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-complete.text:
You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.

I'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.
86585-complete.title: Banner of the Fallen

86585-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-progress.text: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
86585-progress.title: Banner of the Fallen

86758-accept.name: Marek Ironheart
86758-accept.text:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758-accept.title: Twisting the Knife
